groups.rationale: Illustrative hardware diagram and named building blocks distinguish PIC, chassis, backplane and platform I/O, but do not establish a physical installation. Caption/text inspected; figure pixel geometry held.
Cooperative card permission and electrically benign unused pin requirements remain conditional hardware rules, not a distinct generic whole-system information field.
PIC rail eligibility, allowed input voltages and maximum current requirements are an engineering design envelope, not measured supply/current, battery identity or power state.
Previously qualified SOSA donor comparisons already distinguish backplane routing and enumerated front-panel exceptions from actual external connected equipment.

Declared card dimensions, form-factor families, slot pitch, retainer dimensions, connector families and chassis/backplane fit are not an installed slot identifier or physical constituent record; original figure pixels remain held.
Conduction, airflow and liquid cooling designs, adapters and host infrastructure dependencies differ from physical membership or measured thermal performance.

proposed_candidates.label: Candidate — Plug-in card input-power design envelope
proposed_candidates.definition: Source-scoped PIC VS1, VS2, VS3, 3.3V_AUX, VBAT and ALT_VBAT rail eligibility and acceptable input voltage/current envelopes, with card form-factor/applicability context. Distinguish engineered limits from measured current, actual battery, operating power state or universal equipment behavior.

proposed_candidates.label: Candidate — Plug-in card mechanical/mating profile
proposed_candidates.definition: Declared PIC 3U/6U and 100mm/160mm form factor, card and chassis/backplane slot pitch, width/depth/retainer constraints, connector family, rear-transition exclusion and conditional physical compatibility; neither observed placement nor a universal hierarchy. Figure pixels and original ANSI/VITA companions remain held.

proposed_candidates.label: Candidate — Plug-in card cooling method and host fit
proposed_candidates.definition: Card cooling design (conduction, airflow-through or liquid), adapter/chassis fit and required host cooling infrastructure as qualified manufacturer/profile declarations, not measured operation or automatic intermateability.
